applicabilityBasis.summary: USDN represents M locked on Ethereum; Noble holders manually claim accrued rewards and the current redemption app offers Ethereum wM. Under owner ruling D17, crypto payout and increasing token quantities do not establish a payment-stablecoin exclusion. Qualified token-specific legal analysis of the repayment obligation and any securities or deposit exclusion remains necessary.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-01 under D17: Noble's current documentation requires manual rewards claims; the redemption app offers transfer to Ethereum as wM. Neither fact establishes GENIUS applicability or authorization. The prior 2026-06-18 assessment's automatic-rebase and categorical yield-exclusion rationale is withdrawn and preserved in the curation history. Existing issuer identity metadata is retained, but the legally obligated redeeming issuer and holder contracts require product-specific review.
